services.name: 16mm Film Workshop
services.desc: Workshops are $50 each and include all materialsFor more information, or to register, please contact Cat: cat@fluxmediagallery.org Experimental filmmaker Dave Johnson, a member of the RAW STOCK film collective, will teach how to use a 16 mm Bolex camera, and do light meter readings for exposing B&W film. Then participants will shoot and hand process 16 mm negative film, and project the final films! RAW STOCK Film Collective was formed in late 2023 by a group of 4 media artists from Victoria BC: Anthony Carr, Dave Johnson, Trace Nelson and Peter Sandmark. services.name: Table rental
services.desc: FLUX is pleased to present DIPTYCHS by Judith Price and Johanna Householder and My Colombian Dinner Table by Gabriela Torres Vanegas, two media art works which explore connection across the physical and digital divide. Shot over several months during the pandemic lockdowns of 2020-2021, DIPTYCHS: 43° N, 79° W / 48° N, 123° W (the latitude and longitude of Toronto, ON and Victoria, BC respectively) captures a series of Zoom conversations held between Price and Householder, where they play with the possibilities and limitations of online communication.
